info.name: Internet of Things Iot API
iot
Retrieves a list of digital twin adapters within the specified IoT domain.

params.name: iotDomainId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the IoT domain in which to list digital twin resources.

params.name: id

params.description: Filter resources that match the specified URI (DTMI) of the digital twin model.

params.name: limit
params.description:
For list pagination. The maximum number of results per page, or items to return in a
paginated "List" call. For important details about how pagination works, see
[List Pagination](/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/usingapi.htm#nine).

params.name: page
params.description: Page representing the requested page of items.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: Specifies sort order to use, either ASC (ascending) or DESC (descending).

params.name: sortBy
params.description:
The field to sort by. Only one sort order may be provided.
Default order for timeCreated is descending. Default order for displayName is ascending.
